items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Paul's father, you know when he died, he played this funeral on drums

ctx.x: Bill Matthews? Well, I heard Bill a couple of times play drum on the street.
He played last year, I think he played Isidore Barbera. Paul's father, you know when he died, he played this funeral on drums, didn't he?
I believe so, I'm not sure. Yeah, pretty sure.
